note: 0.6 dev.64 (Osama, 8 November 2026). MiG-31BSM: a new Defense Forces card, a copy of the MiG-31BM with all its air-to-air missiles and all its ground-strike loadouts (Kh-59MK, KAB-500, KAB-1500, PBK-500U), same model, cost 220 and defaults, availability 2. The MiG-31BM keeps only the air-to-air loadouts (its ground-strike options are retired) and stays at availability 2. Wheeled cargo trucks have at least 4 availability: LVSR (USMC) 2 -> 4, M1075A1 PLS (Stryker Cavalry, Armored Brigade) 2 -> 4, E13TP (Baltic) 2 -> 4. Tracked supply carriers (DT-30PM Vityaz 3, MT-SM 3) unchanged. Not yet run in a game.
